subject: POC orchestration: NovaEdge success criteria, cadence, owners
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia@novaedge.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@novaedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: proposed POC cadence, success criteria, and owners (next steps)

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a proposed, lightweight orchestration plan so we can get the POC running next week. Please reply with edits and a single thumbs-up if this matches your expectations.

Summary of needs we heard (from call)
- Objective: Validate that Redwood reduces average inference latency for your retrieval-augmented generation pipeline from ~450ms to <200ms at 99th percentile, while maintaining comparable answer relevance for your 5 evaluation prompts.
- Workload profile: mixed chat + batch embeddings, median sequence length ~120 tokens, peak QPS expected 8–12 during simulated load testing.
- Data controls: logs retention 90 days, VPC peering required for test environment.

Proposed POC success criteria (please confirm):
1) Performance: 99th percentile latency under 200ms on 95% of test runs at target QPS.
2) Quality: F1 / relevance score within 5% of your current baseline on the 5 evaluation prompts.
3) Economics: cost-per-1000 tokens estimated reduction >= 25% with suggested batching and caching.
4) Security: VPC peering and audit log access validated in our staging environment.

High-level timeline and cadence (2-week POC)
- Day 0 (kickoff) — alignment on scope, access, and baseline artifacts (we aim for Tue 2027-06-15)
- Day 1–3 — infra & access (VPC peering, API keys, sample dataset load) — owners: Karthik (infra), Alicia (access/whitelists)
- Day 4–8 — run synthetic and recorded traffic runs, collect latency and quality metrics — owners: Marissa (ops), NovaEdge test team
- Day 9–12 — tune batching/quantization profile, run readout suite — owners: Soojin + Marissa
- Day 13 — final readout and decision checkpoint (deliverables: metrics report, MOPs notes, suggested config)

Weekly syncs (short, 30 minutes):
- Kickoff (Tue 6/15) — 60 minutes
- Mid-POC check-in (Fri 6/18) — 30 minutes
- Final readout (Mon 6/28) — 45 minutes (or earlier if ready)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Alicia/Tom: confirm the success criteria above and whether the 2-week window works for you.
- NovaEdge security: please add our staging CIDR block to your allowlist (CIDR in the attached MAP).
- Redwood: we will circulate a one-sheet MLP (mutual action plan) and an SOW draft for signature.

Attachments: 2027-06-10_NovaEdge_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (mutual action plan, owners & dates)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites once we have confirmation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call: proposed POC cadence, success criteria, and owners (next steps)

Thanks, Soojin — this looks good and captures the outcomes from our discussion. A few clarifications / minor edits: 
- Can we extend the tuning window to Day 4–10 (to allow for internal backlog)? Otherwise the timeline is tight for our infra team.
- On success criterion (3) economics: can Redwood run a simple cost-model estimate using our current token distribution? I will share a small CSV.

We’ll get the staging allowlist in place today. Karthik — let us know if you need anything from us for the peering.

Alicia
Director, ML Platform | NovaEdge
